## Checklist

- [ ] `dart format lib test`, `flutter analyze` and `flutter test` pass

- [ ] New UI text is in `lib/l10n/parts` (English and Portuguese) and the generated files are updated
- [ ] No unnecessary comments (only critical, non-obvious ones)
- [ ] Hardware writes were tested carefully and respect device limits
- [ ] Docs and `CHANGELOG.md` updated if users would notice the change
